method: Independent read-only audit of the frozen current source: full-section human review of all 49 runtime implementation files; full-content systematic static scanning of all 69 runtime tests, fixtures and test documentation, with manual review of critical assertions, isolation and failure paths; independent regeneration and byte-hash verification of all 1362 protocol files from the official pinned CLI; SHA-256 verification of all 1852 inventoried source files and scripts/snapshot.mjs aggregate digest before and after review.

methodDetails.implementationReview: Every non-generated runtime implementation file was read in full, including re-reading tool-output truncation segments. Review covered worker authentication/channel revocation, dispatch write fences, bounded native framing/queues/epochs, unknown-result handling, permission subset checks, history and activity freshness, workspace witnesses and bindings, attachment identity/quota/pins, account handoff isolation, configuration authority, extension/MCP validation, realtime ownership and process lifecycle.

testReview.fixturesReview: Current runtime fixture/helper source was read, including isolated loopback provider, native RPC fixtures, terminal cleanup, Windows process-owner fixtures, PTY parser and local model catalog. Remaining test files received whole-content systematic static scans for test declarations, assertions, setup/cleanup, environment/endpoint and failure-path indicators.

officialProtocolVerification.method: Compared archive SHA-512 with fixed official npm registry metadata for @openai/codex 0.164.0-win32-x64; extracted the pinned CLI independently and generated experimental JSON Schema and TypeScript protocols under an isolated .work home; every output name and SHA-256 matched the frozen inventory. This is regeneration/hash verification, not a claim of manual line-by-line reading of generated code.

methodDetails.localExecution: Only official CLI version/protocol generation and a small pure-JavaScript base64-regex boundary check; no test suite or integration test run.

limitations: This is a source audit, not execution evidence for the release. No full suite, targeted Vitest suite, paid inference, real account login, external MCP, or production/online mutation was executed.

Actual Linux systemd/cross-UID confinement, Linux pidfd/subreaper cleanup, Windows process-job execution, remote-control executors, realtime audio/network transport and external OAuth/provider integrations were reviewed statically in this round; their platform/integration execution remains a later release-gate responsibility.
Generated protocol files were independently regenerated and hash-verified against the official pinned 0.164.0 archive; their entire generated text was not manually line-read.

All runtime test and fixture files were systematically scanned, while detailed manual assertion/setup/cleanup review concentrated on critical boundaries and failure paths; test expression counts are static counts and do not represent executed or expanded parameterized cases.
pathNormalization: Absolute paths verified inside the current repository and normalized to inventory-relative paths; original paths retained.
